descriptionChirho: Abstract noun meaning 'deceit, deception, fraud, trickery'—the act or quality of deceiving. All three clusters represent case/number inflections of the same concept with no semantic divergence. S62667 covers nominative/dative/genitive singular, S62668 is genitive singular, S62671 is dative plural. Spanish 'engaño(s)' (deception/deceptions) uniformly, Hindi 'धोख/धोखे/छल/छलों' (deceit/deceptions), Arabic 'غُرُورُ/الخِداعِ/خِداعاتِهِم' (vanity/deceit/their-deceptions), Korean '속임/속임수/속임들' (deception/trick/deceptions), Swahili 'udanganyifu/hadaa' (deceitfulness/deception). The multilingual evidence confirms a single abstract concept across all occurrences.
